title: TUI or static HTML inbox
lead: A TUI or a local static HTML page for clearing the inbox faster.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** a hosted service or web server (v1 non-goal).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Listed in the Later tier to speed up batch answering.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
Gap: no acceptance criteria in PROJECT.md. Choose TUI or HTML with the owner
first, then write tests for that surface.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Gap: PROJECT.md leaves the choice between TUI and HTML open. Plan with the
owner before starting.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The project test command passes.
- `slicer check --json` is clean.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body:
Worktree under `.worktrees/` on a feature branch. No commit unless the owner
asks; no AI attribution.
